senses.gloss: m. (Inf. Hif. of נוּף) waving ceremony in the Temple.—יום ה׳ (Lev. XXIII, 10—12) the second day of Passover.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 4:3">R. Hash. IV, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 3:12">Succ. III, 12</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Challah 1:1:21">Y. Ḥall. I, 57ᶜ</cite> top; a. e.—

<cite ref="Tosefta Arakhin 1:11">Tosef. Arakh. I, 11</cite> <he>ביום ה׳</he> on the same week-day as the second day of Passover; <cite ref="Arakhin 9b:17">Arakh. 9ᵇ</cite>; v. <cite ref="P00491"><he>עִיבּוּר</he></cite>.
